name: Interior lighting design
intro: Light a room from the luminaires' photometry files: the mean, lowest and highest lux on the workplane, uniformity, glare, walls and ceiling, and watts per square metre, with the light bounced off the room's surfaces. A design aid: check it against the standard and your own judgement.
host.none: This app has no rooms or drawing to read from. Type the outline below.
room.none: No closed shapes found. Select one, or type the outline below.
room.outline: Outline (x, y in millimetres, one corner per line)
lum.generic: A typical figure for this kind of luminaire, not a maker's: load the maker's file for a real design.
mode.plan.note: Finds the fewest luminaires, in an even grid, that reach the mean lux (and uniformity) you type.
mode.grid.note: Luminaires in an even grid: one in the middle of each cell of the room.
mode.rows.note: Rows of luminaires, evenly spread, along the room's x or y direction.
preset.workshop.medium: Workshop: medium bench and machine work
draw.done: Drew {n} luminaires and the lux values.
map.alt: Lux on the workplane, dark blue lowest to yellow highest, luminaires as white dots
map.note: Lux on the workplane: dark blue lowest, yellow highest ({max} lx).
note.model: Direct light from the luminaires' photometry plus the light bounced off floor, walls and ceiling as diffuse reflectors. No furniture, columns or inner walls block light, no windows or daylight: a room that is not a simple box is a little too bright in its bays.
note.llf: Lux are maintained values: the light loss factor is applied to every figure.
note.ugr: UGR is an estimate from the CIE 117 formula with the luminaires' candela and luminous opening, at initial flux, for four observers at 1.2 m: compare it with the maker's own UGR table.
note.opening: A photometry file gave no luminous opening, so 0.1 × 0.1 m was assumed for the glare figure.
err.room: The outline needs at least three corners that enclose some area.
err.height: The ceiling height must be between 0.5 and 60 m.
err.workplane: The workplane must be below the ceiling.
err.noluminaires: There are no luminaires to calculate.
err.empty: No luminaire falls inside the room: change the layout.
err.nogrid: The room is too small for a calculation grid.
err.plan: Type a mean lux to plan for, and use a luminaire with a lumen figure.
err.plan.max: No even grid of up to 400 luminaires reaches that. The best one tried: {n} luminaires, {em} lx. Choose a stronger luminaire or lower the target.

day.note: Samo dnevna svetloba pri standardnem enakomerno oblačnem nebu: kolikšen del zunanje svetlobe prek oken doseže delovno ravnino. Brez odboja od tal, brez stavb ali dreves zunaj, brez sonca.
day.windows: Okna (eno na vrstico: stena, od, širina, višina parapeta, višina nadprage, prepustnost stekla; stena je tista od oglišča 0 do 1 kot 0, od 1 do 2 kot 1 in tako naprej; mm)
day.target: Pokaži, kolikšen del prostora doseže faktor dnevne svetlobe
obs.boxes: Kvadri, ki zakrivajo neposredno svetlobo (enega na vrstico: x0, y0, x1, y1, z0, z1 v mm)
em.every: Vsaka n-ta svetilka je na tokokrogu za nujno razsvetljavo, n =
em.share: Izhodna moč v sili kot delež nazivnih lumnov
em.route: Evakuacijska pot (x, y v mm, ena točka na vrstico)
em.ratio: Pot, največ razmerje med najvišjo in najnižjo vrednostjo
day.share: {p} % delovne ravnine doseže faktor dnevne svetlobe {df} % ali več.
day.dropped: Okna, ki niso ustrezala svoji steni ali višini prostora, so bila izpuščena: {n}.
em.facts: {n} od {of} svetilk je na tokokrogu za nujno razsvetljavo, pri {share} % njihove nazivne moči.
note.daylight: Dnevna svetloba: standardno enakomerno oblačno nebo CIE, okno razdeljeno na majhne celice, svetloba, ki vstopa, se odbija med površinami prostora. Brez odboja od tal, brez stavb, dreves ali napuščev zunaj, brez sonca; steklo prepušča enak delež svetlobe pod vsemi koti; brez okvirjev, letev ali zaves.
note.daylight2: Odprtina okna pušča svetlobo tudi ven, zato stena za steklom ne odbija ničesar. Faktor dnevne svetlobe je samo dnevna svetloba: ne prišteva se k umetni svetlobi zgoraj.
note.obstruct: Pohištvo in pregrade zakrivajo samo neposredno svetlobo; odbita svetloba prehaja skozi njiju. Točke znotraj kvadra so izpuščene. Za kvadrom je prostor nekoliko presvetel, nikoli pretemen.
note.emergency: Nujna razsvetljava: neposredna svetloba na tleh samo od svetilk na tokokrogu za nujno razsvetljavo, pri njihovi izhodni moči v sili. Svetloba, odbita od sten in stropa, je zanemarjena.
note.emergency2: Mejne vrednosti so tipične vrednosti v slogu EN 1838, niso preverjene glede na veljavno izdajo in čakajo na pregled svetlobnega inženirja. Znaki, trajanje in čas preklopa niso preverjeni.
err.nowindows: Nobeno okno ne ustreza: preverite številko stene, položaj in višino.
err.noemergency: Nobena svetilka ni na tokokrogu za nujno razsvetljavo.
err.win.edge: Okno je na steni, ki je prostor nima.
err.win.fit: Okno ne ustreza dolžini svoje stene.
err.win.t: Prepustnost stekla mora biti večja od 0 in največ 1.
bim.noroom: Ta prostor ni več med prostori modela: ponovno preberite prostore in ga izberite.
